raw.details:
About the Event

Web Vision is a website redesign challenge for first-year and second-year students. Participants must identify shortcomings in existing websites and develop improved versions focusing on user experience, problem-solving, product thinking, and innovation. The event encourages participants to think creatively, collaborate effectively, and transform ideas into practical digital solutions.

Event Format

Quiz Screening

A time-bound, proctored online assessment may be conducted depending on the number of registrations. This round will evaluate participants’ technical knowledge, logical reasoning, and analytical thinking.

  • All team members must participate together.
  • Teams will be ranked according to their quiz scores.
  • Approximately the top 60% of teams will qualify for the next round.
  • The quiz duration, format, and tie-breaking rules will be announced by the organizers.
  • If registrations are limited, the organizing committee may skip this round and allow eligible teams to proceed directly to the next stage.

Challenge Guidelines

Participants are expected to identify problems and propose meaningful improvements through creative thinking and effective implementation.

  • Teams must identify problems and propose meaningful improvements.
  • Participants should prioritize functional, well-thought-out prototypes over unnecessary features.
  • AI integration is optional and should add meaningful value to the solution.
  • Teams must submit their work before the deadline and be prepared to explain their decisions to the judges.
  • Further challenge details and submission instructions will be announced at the beginning of the round.

Rules and Code of Conduct

All participants must maintain fair competition and professional conduct throughout the event.

  • All team members must contribute meaningfully to the project.
  • Plagiarism, misrepresentation, and violations of tool restrictions are prohibited.
  • Copying other teams’ work or seeking unauthorized external assistance is prohibited.
  • Participants must not interfere with other teams or attempt unauthorized access to systems or accounts.
  • API keys, passwords, and confidential information must not be exposed.
  • All submissions must meet the stipulated deadline and be ready for demonstration.
  • Rule violations may result in disqualification.
  • The judges’ decisions will be final.
